item.title: June Downtime
item.description:
Announcement

Owner Rota will be offline starting May 18, 2026 for an indefinite period. We expect to be back online in June 2026.

Service Impact

  • Creation of free servers is temporarily disabled from May 18.
  • The VortexSpace project will not be ignored; our COO Marcel1kub will handle tickets and provide support.

Panel URL Update

The control panel URL has changed:

Old: https://panel.vortexspace.it
New: https://panel.vortexspace.one

Infrastructure Improvements

  • No downtime for existing servers.
  • The Lava2 component has been removed to improve overall stability.

We are committed to delivering the best possible service. Thank you for using VortexSpace. Once we are back online, we will provision all necessary servers.

item.title: Free Public Lavalink
item.description:
Running a music bot on Discord shouldn’t be a struggle, and it definitely shouldn’t cost you a fortune.

If you’re looking for a stable, reliable, and most importantly, free Lavalink node for your Discord bot, you’ve come to the right place.

Today, we are officially opening our public Lavalink infrastructure to the community.

The problem with “Free” music hosting

We’ve all been there. You find a “free” Lavalink host, set up your bot, and everything works great for a week. Then, the latency spikes, the node goes offline, or the provider suddenly shuts down without warning.

item.title: New Node
item.description:
Hey there, builders. Big news from the VortexSpace Host.

We told you we were building something different, and today we’re proving it. The migration is complete, and the performance is better than ever.

NL1 to IT1: We’re home.

The migration from our old NL1 (Netherlands) node to the brand new IT1 (Italy) node is officially successful.

VortexSpace is now officially running from its home base. Low latency, Italian power, and zero downtime during the switch. Italy is now on Top!

item.title: The Story of VortexSpace Project
item.description:
Hey there, developer. Welcome to VortexSpace

We’re not anothing “Free Hosting” page full of hidden limits, forced ads and broken promises. We’re VortexSpace, The Italian Free Hosting Platform built for real small projects.

Built in Italy. For everyone.

We started because we were tired of ther same story:

You build something cool, a Discord bot for your community, a small website. and then you hit the wall.

Paywalls. Ads injected into your code. “Free” plans that die after 30days. Or worse.. services that just disappear overnight.
